column3: Barrel re-export of the four run modes (interactive, print, json, rpc) plus the RpcClient class and wire types, so embedders never reach into modes/rpc/.

Binary PNG asset (539,053 bytes, verified 89 50 4E 47 signature + IEND trailer) shown by the "pi has joined Earendil" banner; image data with no line-by-line content, its only contract is the filename and image/png mime at the call site.
The /bug flow: consent dialog naming the destination host, optional model-written summary instead of the transcript, then upload or zip export; the report is recorded as a session entry.
Shared layout: a follow:"end" ScrollView transcript (overscroll chain) over a fixed dock of pending/status/widgets/editor(minSize 3)/footer.
XBM easter egg: a 31x36 "Armin" bitmap rendered with half blocks under one of seven random reveal effects; the rain effect drops settle onto the silhouette's target row.
Renders an assistant message (text + merged thinking runs) with a per-run click-to-toggle thinking override; wraps the output in OSC 133 shell-integration zone markers.
OAuth sign-in URL with click and copy hints; hosts call copy() because a long URL wraps and cannot be clicked as a whole under SSH/tmux.
Streaming bash output; dim colour marks "!!" commands whose output is excluded from model context; applies context truncation then a 20-visual-line preview and names the full-output path.
Bordered cancellable loader for extension UI; a non-cancellable instance still exposes an AbortSignal so callers have one code path.
Collapsed/expanded branch-summary block on the customMessageBg panel, toggled by a left click.
Collapsed/expanded compaction summary; the collapsed line states the token count the compaction replaced.

Enable/disable extensions, skills, prompts and themes at global or project scope; project scope has a three-state inherit/load/unload override whose next state is derived from the inherited global state.
One-second countdown timer used by the retry indicator and dialog timeouts; ticks immediately so the first frame is correct.
Main input editor; dispatches named AppKeybinding actions, embeds the working status in its own top border with three width-degradation steps, and lets extension shortcuts take precedence.
Renders an extension-produced custom session entry; a throwing renderer produces a visible "[type] renderer failed" box rather than an empty row.
Renders an extension-produced custom message; the extension renderer owns its styling, and a throwing renderer falls back to the default [type] label plus markdown body.
Unified-diff renderer with colour plus word-level intra-line highlighting, applied only when the hunk is exactly one removed and one added line.
Width-adaptive horizontal rule; docstring warns the global theme can be undefined under jiti's separate module cache, so an explicit colour fn should be passed.
The "pi has joined Earendil" banner; the PNG is read once and cached as base64 and the banner renders without it if the asset is missing.
Lazy loader for the fullscreen 3D easter eggs; captures the screen before importing the module and refuses to play unless the TUI is a TuiAltScreen.

Fullscreen 3D animation: the screen dissolves into braille dust while a ray-cast block model spins and plays a deterministic sliding puzzle; the exit timeline runs backwards so the screen reassembles. Partially read (lines 1-350 and 860-979 in full; the rasteriser/starfield/pose maths skimmed).
Multi-line editor for extension dialogs with Ctrl+G external-editor support; the TUI is stopped and restarted in a finally block.
Single-line extension input; an optional timeout turns the title into a live countdown and cancelling the countdown calls the cancel callback so the promise always settles.
Generic list-of-strings selector for extension dialogs; accepts raw j/k/Enter as well as the configured keybindings and forwards app.tools.expand.
First-run dialog (theme then analytics opt-in); the whole dialog is rebuilt on every change so theme previews recolour all its text.

Status line (cwd, git, session, tokens, cache rate, cost, context %); the whole-session usage scan is cached and invalidated by the (session, id, leaf, entryCount, model) tuple, derived from the fact that appends move the leaf.
Barrel re-export of the extension-facing components, including truncateToVisualLines and renderDiff so extension renderers behave like the built-ins.
Formats keybinding hints; alt is displayed as option on macOS and the key/description are two-tone for scannability.

OAuth/API-key login dialog that replaces the editor; a single Input is reused across flows, cancel() aborts the shared controller and rejects the pending promise, and app.message.copy copies the sign-in URL.
Chains extension markdown transformers; each receives the previous output and a transformer that throws is skipped rather than being fatal.
Replaces mermaid code blocks with Unicode diagrams, but only when the art fits the available width; rows are encoded as code spans with a backtick fence longer than any run in the content.
The /model picker: renders from the cached snapshot immediately and refreshes catalogs in the background, downgrading a timeout or per-provider error to a warning while keeping the cached list.
The /login and /logout provider picker; distinguishes a matching configured type (green) from a mismatched one (amber) and names the credential source (env var vs stored).
The 4x2-cell pi logo drawn with half blocks in fixed brand colours; Apple Terminal gets a text wordmark because it misaligns half blocks.
The /login menu whose Radius option shimmers in the brand colours; the shimmer replaces the parent selector's rendered line and degrades to plain text if the match fails.

Picks which models the Ctrl+P cycle visits and in what order; null means "all enabled" and an explicit list collapses back to null when it covers everything; changes are session-only until explicitly saved.
Search grammar and ranking: re:<pattern> for regex, quoted phrases for exact, bare words for fuzzy, and an unclosed quote falls back to plain tokenisation instead of erroring.

The /resume picker: two lazily and separately loaded scopes with their own AbortControllers, threaded or flat sort modes, rename, and a delete that prefers trash over unlink and treats a gone file as success.

The /settings panel: ~35 SettingItems over a config object with one callback per setting; the theme setting opens a single/automatic submenu and the per-model thinking override is a looping SteppedSubmenu.
Reusable SelectSubmenu and SteppedSubmenu; a step's options may be a function of the shared context, Esc goes back one step and deletes that step's context key.
Yes/no picker for inline image rendering, preselecting the current value.
Renders a skill invocation block collapsed/expanded; only the skill block is rendered here, the accompanying user message is rendered separately by the host.
The working/retry/compaction/branch-summary indicators; renderInBorder and renderSpinnerInBorder let them be drawn inside the editor's border, and the retry indicator owns a countdown.
Theme picker that previews live via onSelectionChange so the whole UI recolours while the list is open.
Text rebuilt from a callback on every invalidation, because a plain Text freezes the colours it was constructed with and would go stale after a theme change.
Thinking-level picker with per-level token-cost descriptions and a separate set-as-default binding.

Renders one tool call: renderCall/renderResult with a persistent state object and a context carrying executionStarted, argsComplete, isPartial, expanded, isError and durationMs; a throwing renderer falls back to a generic rendering.

The /tree picker: branch-first ordering, folding, filtering and horizontal panning; filtering re-attaches descendants to the nearest visible ancestor and recomputes indentation so chains do not drift, and the selection survives an empty filter result.
The /trust picker; the saved decision is shown with its inheritance chain and the selection is pre-positioned on the saved option.
The /fork picker over user messages, chronological, defaulting to the most recent, with each row showing "Message N of M"; an empty list auto-cancels.
Renders a user message; the markdown component pads and colours its own background (a Box would duplicate every line) and ordered-list markers and backslash escapes are preserved.
Shared "collapse to N visual lines" primitive (after wrapping, not logical lines) with a per-width cache and a hint placed before the kept tail or after the kept head.
Opens the editor buffer in $EDITOR; uses async spawn rather than spawnSync because on Windows a synchronous call keeps libuv's console input read active and races vim for the input buffer.

The TUI hub (7,082 lines): owns the component tree, subscribes to AgentSessionEvent, drives the two-dimensional steer/follow-up queue, the separate compaction queue, the dialog stack, renderer swapping, /reload ordering, three-tier shutdown (graceful, signal, dead-terminal) and the crash-extension hint.
Coordinator sharing one in-flight catalog refresh per runtime via a WeakMap, with per-caller cancellation and the shared operation aborted only when the last waiter leaves.
Two search-text builders; the selector variant deliberately keeps the bare model id out of the leading position so provider-prefixed queries rank first.

Reports working/blocked/done/error/idle to the terminal via OSC 7501, limited to the session name, dialog titles and the first line of errors; the latest assistant message decides the outcome so a retried error is replaced by its success.
The /share flow; the export appends a pi.share entry carrying the system prompt and tool schemas; destination is auto/radius/gist and an explicit radius refuses to fall back to a gist.
Built-in dark theme: 50 colour tokens in OKHSL plus a vars block and an export block for HTML output; three tokens are omitted and fall back.
Built-in light theme with the same token set as dark.json, which is what makes the automatic light/dark theme pair possible.

Generates a whole theme from the terminal's reported colours: per-family hues, target-lightness contrast curves, tokens solved in dependency order, a binary-search relaxation when a mid-gray background cannot fit, and a 4.5:1 WCAG floor on body text.

Applies the theme setting and keeps it in sync with the terminal; the colour query has a 100 ms timeout AND a late-reply callback, colours are merged field by field, and the controller is re-bound when the renderer is swapped.
JSON-Schema validation for user themes, deliberately kept out of theme.ts because typebox costs ~17 MB of module graph; the error names the missing required colour tokens.

Token metadata with slot, description and fallback; defineThemeTokens validates at module load that every fallback exists and is in the same colour slot, and the ThemeColor/ThemeBg types are derived from the data.

The Theme class, registry, file watcher and TUI helpers; the theme singleton lives on globalThis under a Symbol.for key so node and jiti share it, ANSI sequences are precomputed, variable refs detect cycles, and the watcher keeps the last good theme while a file is being rewritten.
Composition root for the TUI plus createInteractiveTuiReference, a Proxy that re-resolves the underlying TUI on every access so components survive a renderer swap.

Converts internal session events to the wire shape: cumulative assistant snapshots are removed but constant-size usage, tool-call ids and tool names are kept; toolcall_start asserts its own invariant.

One-shot mode; the authoritative answer is the final assistant message, and the exit code encodes the outcome (error/aborted/length -> 1), with SIGTERM/SIGHUP killing detached children and exiting 143/129.
Strict LF-only JSONL framing that deliberately does not use Node readline, because readline splits on U+2028/U+2029 which are valid inside JSON strings.

Typed client that spawns the agent in RPC mode; pending requests are rejected on child exit with the collected stderr, event listeners are iterated over a snapshot, and prompt() returns the disposition instead of waiting for the run.

The headless JSONL server; a prompt responds only after the session's preflight succeeds and reports the disposition, extension dialogs resolve to their default on abort/timeout, and every TUI-only method is an explicit documented no-op.
The typed wire contract: separate command and response unions so a wrong shape is a type error; every response carries the command name; get_commands merges extension, prompt and skill sources.

The install/remove/update/list/config CLI; parsePackageCommand returns structured errors, the managed self-update stages an npm ci, verifies the new binary by running --version, and flips current-version atomically under a proper-lockfile lock.
Shebang entry that forces --mode rpc, sets process.title and the PI_CODING_AGENT/AI_AGENT env markers, and silences process.emitWarning so Node warnings cannot corrupt the JSONL stdout.
Abort helpers; raceWithAbortSignal keeps observing the abandoned operation so an abort is not an unhandled rejection, and re-checks signal.aborted after wiring the listener to close the race window.
ANSI stripping plus splitIncompleteAnsiSuffix, which holds back a trailing unfinished escape sequence (capped at 256 chars) so a sequence split across two streamed chunks cannot corrupt the output.
Parses CHANGELOG.md into versioned entries and rewrites its links, pinning main/master blob and tree links to the tagged URL and mapping the legacy pi-mono repos.
Cross-platform spawn wrappers; waitForChildProcess re-arms a 100 ms idle timer on every chunk after exit, because a fixed deadline would silently lose output still written by a detached descendant.
Runs a clipboard helper detached on POSIX with no output pipe (so a daemonised clipboard owner is not stopped by Ctrl+Z), with a timeout, a 50 MB cap and swallowed stdin errors.

Reads a clipboard image across platforms with a three-valued result (undefined = backend failed, null = no image), so an empty Wayland clipboard cannot fall through to stale X11 contents; WSL falls back to PowerShell.

Text clipboard across macOS/Windows/Linux/Termux/WSL; OSC 52 is used for remote or headless sessions only, the WSL path round-trips through a file to avoid console-code-page mangling, and each failure names the exact missing tool.
Emits a deprecation warning once per distinct message, with a test-only reset of the emitted set.
Hand-written EXIF orientation reader for JPEG and WebP (both endiannesses, with the WebP "Exif\0\0" prefix and RIFF even-padding handled) plus the eight transforms.
YAML front-matter extraction; an unterminated block is returned whole with empty front-matter, and CRLF is normalised.
fs.watch with an error handler and a close that cannot throw; a synchronous throw from watch() becomes the same onError callback.

Parses a git package source; the safety check runs on both the raw and percent-decoded form and rejects NUL, backslash, a leading slash and any .. segment, and a bare host/path is only accepted with the git: prefix.
Hand-written ambient declarations for the highlight.js deep imports, so the large upstream type surface never enters the build.
Minimal HTML entity decoding; decodeHtmlEntityAt refuses an entity longer than 16 characters, bounding the work a stray & can cause.

Converts images to PNG for the Kitty graphics protocol; ensurePngTranscoder registers Photon as pi-tui's transcoder only on Kitty terminals and only once, with an onRegistered callback to re-render text fallbacks.
Normalises and resizes an image before it enters the prompt, returning model-readable hints (converted-from note and the coordinate-mapping dimension note).

The resize algorithm: dimension caps, then PNG and JPEG and take the smaller, then decreasing JPEG quality, then 25 % dimension steps down to 1x1, refusing to ship an over-budget image; worker replies carry a type tag because node --watch posts its own messages on the worker channel.
Worker-thread entry point for image resizing; validates the request shape and always replies with a tagged result-or-error response.

Runs the resize in a worker thread so WASM does not block the TUI; the bytes are copied before transfer (transfer detaches the caller's buffer) and it falls back to in-process resizing when the worker cannot load.
Strips // comments and trailing commas from JSON using two alternation regexes that match string literals first.

Bounded retrying fetch for idempotent management requests: timeoutMs is a terminal overall budget, attemptTimeoutMs aborts only the current attempt, and the doc forbids its use for agent/model operations.
Image mime sniffing that validates structure, not just the signature (PNG IHDR plus acTL animation check, BMP header consistency) from the first 4100 bytes.

Opens a URL or file without ever invoking a shell; on Windows it uses rundll32 url.dll,FileProtocolHandler because cmd /c start re-parses metacharacters and would make attacker-controlled URLs injectable.
The single place pi writes output files; mode 0600 and the wx flag ("never follows a link someone else placed at the path"), currently in the OS temp directory.

Path canonicalisation, normalisation and containment; getCwdRelativePath is the single is-inside-this-root predicate reused by the managed install, the quarantine and the config selector, and getFileRevision stamps dev:ino:size:mtimeNs:ctimeNs.

Lazy, failure-tolerant wrapper around the Photon WASM library; fs.readFileSync is patched for the duration of the import to redirect a missing photon_rs_bg.wasm read to a fallback next to the executable, then restored.
One-line helper returning pi's detailed User-Agent for its own network requests.

Shell and PowerShell discovery, the shell environment, binary-output sanitisation (including the U+FFF9-FFFB interlinear characters that crash string-width) and tracked detached children killed on parent signals.
One-line abort-aware sleep that rejects with "Aborted" when the signal fires.

22 languages registered eagerly and the rest loaded lazily in a setImmediate after the first frame; highlight.js's HTML is parsed into a scope stack and themed here, so no span markup reaches the terminal.
BOM handling: splitBom returns the BOM separately, stripBom removes it; used by the theme loader, the changelog reader and the package manager.

Normalises image blocks produced by tools (extensions, MCP bridges) before they enter history, because an oversized image makes the provider reject the whole conversation; a conversion failure keeps the original block rather than deleting the tool's output.

Ensures fd and rg exist, downloading from GitHub releases; the latest version is resolved from the release-page redirect rather than the rate-limited API, extraction tries tar/unzip/PowerShell in order and lists every attempt, and the extract dir is unique per download because startup downloads run concurrently.

The "is there a newer pi?" check; formatVersionCheckError unwraps Node's generic "fetch failed" to the errno codes, isNewerPackageVersion degrades to a string compare for non-semver tags, and PI_OFFLINE / PI_SKIP_VERSION_CHECK short-circuit it.

Works around Windows locking a loaded .node file: reads process.report's sharedObjects, renames each loaded addon into a quarantine dir under node_modules and copies it back so the path exists but is unlocked.
Detects WSL from WSL_DISTRO_NAME/WSLENV and by grepping /proc/version, so it also works in a container with neither set.
Writes the small classic ZIP archives used by bug reports with no dependency, assembling the local headers, central directory and EOCD by hand over zlib.deflateRawSync and zlib.crc32.
